signed_selector.source: ScriptArgs::IDs RVA0x2818f0; ScriptAction.Execute0x252165..0x2521dd reads each four-byte ID and forwards it without a positive-ID check.
signed_selector.portable_validation: Action selectors accept finite integral signed32 numbers, including 0 and -1. Type, fractional, finite, range and array-size validation remain. Storage and allocation identity guards are separate.
signed_selector.plural_precedence: Ids replaces Id when present; DestinationIds replaces DestinationId for destination selection.

active_selection.policy: Resolve selected IDs against actual manager membership and skip absent owners; retained diagnostic disposal snapshots are not active targets.
active_selection.implementation: Existing object_runtime targets() owns active-target resolution after signed ID parsing.

add_to_group.policy: The action reads Names with Name fallback, creates named group, then forwards raw IDs. World.AddToGroup searches map records then active Things; if neither contains the ID, null pointer test at0x314228 and jump0x31422b return without mutation/error. Applies to any absent signed32 selector, not only zero.
add_to_group.portable_boundary: Skip absent registry IDs. Extant retained/unsupported states still pass through existing active() validation and reject where required. Empty None-group mutation remains unsupported.
add_to_group.group_creation_order: ScriptAction.Execute0x252156 calls GroupManager.Add0x30c9d0 before reading ScriptArgs.Ids at0x252168 and before calling World.AddToGroup at0x2521dd. Thus an empty or all-missing ID selection still creates/resolves each nonempty named group. The World helper itself performs no mutation for missing ID, but that does not undo the enclosing action group creation.

other_consumers: Parsing is shared; direct consumers retain their existing resolution checks. This recovery does not claim every direct object action ignores missing owners.
verification_boundary: Recovered matching native static behavior. Coordinator owns real-input and sanitizer validation; no scalar return semantics for blocked SpawnObstacle inferred from this contract.
motion_selection: One validated signed32 decoder supplies screen Teleport, screen guards and registered world-actor selection. Plural selectors take precedence, including empty Lua tables represented by SourceValue empty objects; scalar or non-array plural data rejects. Missing owners are filtered against actual registration before mutation. Source runWithDestination RVA0x25eea0 resolves through actual World membership. Existing sorting/unique and unsupported name/motion branches remain.
